youtube_title: Indiana Dunes State Park, 1966: three young women who never came home
body: On Saturday, July 2, 1966, three young women from the Chicago area went to Indiana Dunes State Park in Porter County: Ann Miller, 21, Patricia Blough, 19, and Renee Bruhl, 19. Around noon, witnesses said, they got into a small white boat with a young man at the wheel. Their clothes and belongings stayed on the beach, and Ann's car stayed in the parking lot. The women were never found. Investigators chased many theories, and none was ever proven. 60 years later, the case remains unsolved. On Saturday, July 2, 1966, three young women from the Chicago area went to Indiana Dunes State Park in Porter County. They never came home.
Ann Miller was 21. Patricia Blough and Renee Bruhl were 19. They drove over in Ann's car and went down to the sand by Lake Michigan. Around noon, witnesses said, they got into a small white boat with a young man at the wheel.
Their clothes and belongings stayed on the beach. Ann's car stayed in the lot. The women were never found. Investigators chased many theories, and none was ever proven. 60 years later, the case remains unsolved.
